spans.text: SORN USDA/FPAC-2 States: Program documents are destroyed within 6 years after end of participation. However, FPAC is under a records freeze. According to Records Management DR3080-001 Disposition of Inactive Records: Records and other documents that are no longer sufficiently active to warrant retention in office space shall be removed as rapidly as possible by: (a) transfer to a Federal Records Center, or (b) transfer to a records retention facility meeting the requirements of 36 CFR Chapter 12, Subchapter B Records | | Management, Subpart K, 1228.224 through 1228.244, or (c) if authorized, by disposal.
